entries.title: Batches, Knowledge and Automation on your iPhone and iPad
entries.body: The Panels tab on your iPhone and iPad now shows the app's own panels your computer shows: Batches while batched pull requests are on, Knowledge once your first mate keeps some, and Automation once a rule is saved. Tasks and Activity keep their own tabs.

picture.alt: The Panels tab on an iPhone showing the Automation panel with a saved rule, Morning summary, and its next run time.
